about.title: A few words about the pilot
about.p1: Computer Science student at WSB Merito University in Gdańsk, 3rd year. I specialise in frontend, but I enjoy working across the whole stack — from the interface to the API and the database.
about.p2: Main focus: Fullstack — React/Vue + Node.js. I'm looking for an internship or a job as a Frontend / Fullstack Developer.

offer.title: What I can do for you

items.title: Frontend
items.text: Interfaces in React and Next.js (and Vue and Nuxt) with TypeScript: responsive, polished and with well-considered animations.

items.title: Backend
items.text: REST APIs in Node.js, PostgreSQL or Supabase, data validation and server-side logic, as in OTO OKO.

items.title: Mobile
items.text: React Native and Expo apps that work offline: a local SQLite database, a message queue and sync, as in Backstage.

items.title: Teamwork
items.text: I work in teams of four: Git, code review and clean architecture. In Backstage I lead the team and look after testing.
